# Millionærklubben Eksklusiv: Sådan tænker den professionelle investor – gode tips og tricks til at finde attraktive aktier Del 1 Del 2

**Feed**: millionaerklubben  
**Published**: 2026-09-24  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

In this Danish Millionærklubben live panel, Nykredit's Frederik Engholm, Otto Mønsted's Nina Movin and Andersen Capital's Michael Friis Jørgensen discuss the AI theme, the energy transition and which sectors to over- or underweight. Nykredit is overweight IT, which its models rank as the cheapest sector with the best momentum, and pharma, and underweight energy, industrials and transport. Michael doubts the economics of AI and prefers energy supply and metals (NKT, Vestas, Siemens, the clean-energy ETF), while Nina plays AI broadly through liquid large caps (Alphabet, Microsoft) and holds ABB, Siemens Energy, Merck, Novo and JPMorgan. All three avoid or are underweight consumer stocks.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 GOOGL — Alphabet | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Nina's preferred broad AI play: it has an LLM, consumer reach and chips.

#### Reasoning

Guest Nina Movin (Otto Mønsted) plays AI broadly and favours liquid large caps. She has leaned heavily on Alphabet as a company that owns the whole AI value chain: Gemini LLM, consumer distribution and in-house chips. This suits investors without deep technical insight.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI competition erodes Alphabet's position
- if AI index concentration unwinds sharply

> *"fremfor alt har jeg jo kørt meget på Alphabet, fordi jeg mener, den har det hele"*

---

### 🟢 MSFT — Microsoft | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Nina: Microsoft has come very far and offers a broad set of LLM models to customers.

#### Reasoning

Guest Nina Movin names Microsoft as a second broad AI holding. It offers customers many LLM models and funds the AI buildout from large existing cash flows, which Frederik also notes.

#### Sell Triggers

- if enterprise AI adoption stalls
- if AI capex overinvestment hits returns

> *"sådan noget som Microsoft, som jeg jo synes er kommet utrolig langt"*

---

### 🟢 NKT — NKT | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Michael holds NKT in his energy-supply thesis. Nina says grid connection is the bottleneck.

#### Reasoning

Guest Michael Friis Jørgensen invests in energy supply rather than AI software or chips. His reasons are data-center power demand, energy security and geopolitics, and his view that only renewables can be built within about 4 years. Nina adds that grid connection, where NKT operates, is the bottleneck.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the data-center buildout slows sharply
- if new technology in the transition fails

> *"Jamen, så snider NQT Vestas Siemens"*

---

### 🟢 VWS — Vestas | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Named by Michael as one of his energy-supply investments.

#### Reasoning

Part of Michael's energy-transition and energy-supply basket. He argues renewables are the only capacity that can be built quickly enough for data-center demand, and that falling battery prices raise the value of green power.

#### Sell Triggers

- if energy transition momentum stalls

> *"Jamen, så snider NQT Vestas Siemens"*

---

### 🟡 ENR — Siemens Energy | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Nina has made a lot of money on Siemens Energy (gas and wind). Michael also names Siemens.

#### Reasoning

Both guests hold Siemens exposure as a way to play energy transition and energy security. Gas turbines are sold out and power demand from data centers keeps rising. Nina warns that the new technology in the space can fail.

#### Sell Triggers

- if energy demand growth fades
- if new technology fails

> *"Siemens Energy, hvor du både har gas og vind"*

---

### 🟡 ABB — ABB | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Nina has made a lot of money on ABB through the electrification theme.

#### Reasoning

Guest Nina Movin names ABB as a key winner of the electrification and energy-transition theme, which she still sees as super relevant.

#### Sell Triggers

- if electrification theme loses momentum

> *"sådan noget som ABB er jo noget af det, vi har tjent rigtig mange penge på"*

---

### 🟠 BE — Bloom Energy | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Price has come down after the AI hype. Michael likes the company but only holds it via the ETF.

#### Reasoning

Michael says Bloom made up about 12% of the clean-energy ETF and then halved. He likes the company but not its hyped valuation. After the price fall it is still one of the solutions, but he wants no direct exposure beyond the ETF.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI hype re-inflates valuation

> *"jeg skal ikke have mere Bloom Energy"*

---

### 🟡 MRK — Merck | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Nina: one of her good companies. Keytruda combination approvals should sustain cash flow past the 2028 patent expiry.

#### Reasoning

Nina likes pharma with broad portfolios and strong cash flow for acquisitions. Merck is her pick despite Keytruda's 2028 patent cliff, because many approved combination treatments (including with Moderna) should extend cash flow. She calls it a bet. Nykredit's Frederik is also overweight pharma.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Keytruda patent cliff hits cash flow harder than expected
- if US drug pricing regulation tightens

> *"netop Merck er jo et af mine gode selskaber"*

---

### 🟡 JPM — JPMorgan | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

A long-time holding of Nina's that she still keeps.

#### Reasoning

Asked whether JPMorgan should stay in the portfolio, Nina confirms she still holds it. She also says she should have had more exposure to banks and insurance.

> *"Ja, den bor der endnu."*

---

### 🟡 NOVO-B — Novo Nordisk | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Nina holds Novo within her pharma exposure, although many have lost money on it.

#### Reasoning

Nina briefly confirms she owns Novo as part of her preference for large, known pharma companies. Nykredit is overweight pharma, arguing the fear of Trump's drug-price regulation has been overdone.

#### Sell Triggers

- if US pricing regulation hurts margins

> *"Jeg har også novo"*

---
